bonuses.name: 'Ere We Go!
bonuses.text: If this Threat is Engaged at the start of its Turn, it gains +2 damage to melee attacks.

abilities.name: Get Stuck In!
abilities.text: The Ork Boy Charges the nearest enemy, firing their Slugga wildly. Make a Ballistic Skill (A) Test against the target's Defence as part of the Charge; if it hits, it does not deal damage, but all enemies within 30m of the Ork Boy must make a DN3 Fear Test.

options.name: MORE DAKKA!
options.text: For every ten Ork Boyz in the Mob one may have one of the following options (while keeping their Choppa and Slugga):

mobAbilities.name: Anarchy
mobAbilities.text: Whenever the Mob rolls a Complication, the Mob starts infighting and inflicts 1d3 Shock on itself. Add 1d3 Shock to this damage for every ten Boyz in the Mob.

mobAbilities.name: Mob Rule
mobAbilities.text: A Mob of Ork Boyz gains +1 bonus Icon to any Resolve Tests. This increases by +1 for every ten Boyz.
